_meta.description: Country energy price and grid CO2 intensity database
_meta.sources: Eurostat nrg_pc_204/nrg_pc_202 (EU prices, H2 2025); EIA Short-Term Energy Outlook (US, H2 2025); Ember Global Electricity Review 2025/2026 (grid CO2); GlobalPetrolPrices.com Q1 2026 (non-EU prices); DEFRA 2026 (UK grid CO2); EPA eGRID 2023 (US grid CO2)
_meta.note: Residential/household prices. CO2 = grid average location-based emissions intensity, g CO2/kWh. Confidence varies by country - see per-country 'confidence' field.
_meta.confidence_legend: high = official statistical agency figure for the exact metric; medium = derived/converted from an official figure or a consistent secondary aggregator; low = single-source estimate, needs independent verification before publication
